none: PAS FindID 977693: Roman copper alloy coin, probably a sestertius of Faustina II
contea di ritrovamento: Cumbria (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Roman sestertius of Faustina II (AD 147-175), dating to the period c.AD 161-175 (Reece Period 8). Unclear reverse type depicting a standing female figure right? Mint of Rome. Diameter 30mm, and the weight 14.81g. The obverse inscription is FAVSTINA [AVGVSTA]. The reverse inscription is illegible. The coin is damaged and incomplete
